agenda.verbatim: B is closer to a game HUD, the numbered chips feel like a quest tracker, I like that. But the right edge clips and the hero art is a grey placeholder person, which is the generic AI-dashboard look I distrust. Words are mostly consistent (staff pick, deputy, handled) but 'Needs you', 'Your pick', 'Staff pick', 'Optional' are four status vocabularies. 'Go through these' is a weak heading. Skip meaning was clear once I read it; Undo in the banner is good. Map bottom bar is overloaded. Nothing animates in a static mock so I cannot judge feel; I would want a sound and motion on each approve.
